overview.purpose_zh: 用一整块圆表示全部发电量，每一块扇区是一个能源来源的占比，回答“谁占得多、谁占得少”。
works_zh: 各部分加起来正好是一百，读者看的是构成，不是变化
块数控制在两到四块，最大的一块明显突出，一眼就能抓住重点
报告开头需要一句话点出占比最大的来源
uses_zh: 年度能源结构或成本结构的汇报
课堂讲“整体与部分”的占比概念
给非专业读者的一页纸摘要

understanding.read_zh: 先把整个圆看成 100%，再按面积从大到小看。这张图有七块，已经偏挤：先读被高亮的 Coal，记住它刚过四分之一，再把 Gas 和其余小块按大小排一遍。不要试图给每一块都配一句话，听众记不住七个来源。

elements.note_zh: 每一块的角度代表一个来源的占比，所有扇区合起来是整个圆。
颜色和来源名称的对应表；块多的时候，读者要来回对照。
扇区上直接写出占比，省去读者自己估角度。

look_for_zh: Coal 被高亮，是唯一接近四分之一的大块
Fossil 三块颜色同组，合起来刚过半
Oil 只有很薄的一条，是整张图最小的块

observations.en: Coal is the largest slice at 26 percent, just over a quarter of all generation.
observations.zh: 煤是最大的扇区，占 26%，略高于全部发电量的四分之一。

observations.en: Fossil fuels together supply 51 percent, just over half of the mix.
observations.zh: 化石燃料合计供应 51%，略高于能源结构的一半。

observations.en: Oil is the smallest slice at 3 percent.
observations.zh: 石油是最小的扇区，只占 3%。

observations.en: Coal's share is 4 percentage points above gas, at 26 percent against 22 percent.
observations.zh: 煤的份额比天然气高 4 个百分点，为 26% 对 22%。

describe.en: The pie chart breaks electricity generation down by source.
describe.zh: 这张饼图把发电量按能源来源拆开来看。
describe.pattern: The chart breaks down X by Y
alternatives: The chart shows how total generation splits by source.
This pie chart divides one region's electricity mix into its sources.
describe.note_zh: 开头只说要拆什么，不急着报数字。

describe.en: Coal accounts for 26 percent of generation, the largest slice in the chart.
describe.zh: 煤占发电量的 26%，是图中最大的扇区。
describe.pattern: X accounts for + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Coal makes up 26 percent of generation.
Coal represents 26 percent of the total.
describe.note_zh: of 后面必须有整体，不能只说 accounts for 26 percent generation。

describe.en: Coal holds the largest share at 26 percent, with gas next at 22 percent.
describe.zh: 煤的份额最大，为 26%，天然气以 22% 排在后面。
describe.pattern: X has / holds / takes the largest share of + whole
alternatives: Coal takes the largest share of generation, at 26 percent.
The largest share belongs to coal, at 26 percent.
describe.note_zh: 只报前两名，读者就知道这张图的主次，不必逐块列完。

describe.en: Coal supplies just over a quarter of the region's electricity, at 26 percent.
describe.zh: 煤供应了该地区略高于四分之一的电力，占 26%。
alternatives: Coal supplies a little more than a quarter of the region's electricity.
At 26 percent, coal is just over a quarter of the mix.
describe.note_zh: 26% 说 just over a quarter 比说 exactly a quarter 准确。

describe.en: The largest proportion of electricity comes from coal, at 26 percent.
describe.zh: 占比最大的电力来源是煤，为 26%。
describe.pattern: The largest proportion of X comes from Y
alternatives: The largest proportion of generation is coal, at 26 percent.
Coal provides the largest proportion of the region's electricity, at 26 percent.

describe.en: Fossil fuels make up 51 percent of the mix, with coal alone at 26 percent.
describe.zh: 化石燃料占能源结构的 51%，其中仅煤就占 26%。
describe.pattern: X makes up + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Fossil fuels account for 51 percent of the mix.
Coal, gas and oil together make up just over half of generation, at 51 percent.
describe.note_zh: 把三块化石燃料合成一组再报总数，是处理多块饼图的常用办法。

academic.en: The pie chart shows how electricity generation in one region divides by source. Seven sources are displayed, which is more than a pie chart handles well; the large blocks therefore dominate the reading. Coal is the largest at 26 percent, just over a quarter, followed by gas at 22 percent. The three fossil fuels together reach 51 percent, just over half of generation. Renewables account for 35 percent: hydro 15 percent, wind 12 percent and solar 8 percent. Nuclear contributes 14 percent, while oil is the smallest at 3 percent.
academic.zh: 这张饼图显示一个地区的发电量按来源如何划分。图中列出七个来源，对饼图来说偏多，因此阅读时首先看到的是大的扇区。煤最大，占 26%，略高于四分之一；天然气以 22% 紧随其后。三种化石燃料合计达到 51%，刚过发电量的一半。可再生能源占 35%：水电 15%，风电 12%，太阳能 8%。核能占 14%，石油最小，只占 3%。

business.en: Seven slices make a crowded pie, so our report should lead with what matters commercially: coal still holds 26 percent, and fossil fuels together hold 51 percent, just over half of generation. Gas at 22 percent is our second-largest source and the obvious backup if coal is reduced. Renewables stand at 35 percent, split between hydro at 15 percent, wind at 12 percent and solar at 8 percent. Nuclear covers 14 percent, and oil is immaterial at 3 percent. We should frame the planning discussion around fuel-risk exposure in the generation mix.
business.zh: 七块扇区让这张饼图显得拥挤，所以我们的汇报要先讲商业上重要的部分：煤仍占 26%，化石燃料合计占 51%，刚过发电量的一半。天然气以 22% 位居第二，如果减少用煤，它是最直接的替代来源。可再生能源占 35%，其中水电 15%、风电 12%、太阳能 8%。核能占 14%，石油只占 3%，影响很小。我们应该围绕发电结构里的燃料风险来组织规划讨论。

simple.en: This chart shows where one region gets its electricity. Coal is the biggest piece, at 26 percent. Gas is next at 22 percent. Hydro gives 15 percent, wind gives 12 percent, solar gives 8 percent and nuclear gives 14 percent. Oil is a very thin piece at 3 percent. All the fossil fuels together are 51 percent, a little more than half. There are seven pieces, so it is easier to remember the big ones and the total.
simple.zh: 这张图显示一个地区的电从哪里来。煤是最大的一块，占 26%。天然气其次，占 22%。水电占 15%，风电占 12%，太阳能占 8%，核能占 14%。石油是很薄的一块，只占 3%。所有化石燃料加起来是 51%，比一半多一点。图里有七块，记住大的几块和总数就容易些。

language_notes.body_zh: 说占比时，account for、make up、represent 后面都要接“百分比 + of + 整体”。饼图里 of 后面的整体就是全部发电量，省掉 of 句子就不完整。
examples: Coal accounts for 26 percent of generation.
Fossil fuels make up 51 percent of the mix.

language_notes.title_en: just over a quarter, not just a quarter
language_notes.body_zh: 26% 比四分之一多一点，用 just over a quarter 最准确；正好四分之一才能说 exactly a quarter。反过来 22% 是 just under a quarter。分数词比干报数字更有画面，但只在数值真的接近时用。
examples: Coal is just over a quarter of generation, at 26 percent.
Gas is just under a quarter of the mix, at 22 percent.

language_notes.body_zh: 饼图块多时，逐块报数会让听众失去重点。通常只报最大的两三块，再把同类合并，比如把煤、天然气、石油合成化石燃料，一起说 51%。合并后的数字也要能从数据里算出来。
examples: Coal is the largest slice at 26 percent.
The three fossil fuels together make up 51 percent.
